style: Convert the photo in image 0 into a 16-bit pixel art character portrait for a retro adventure game. Head-and-shoulders bust, head centered and filling the upper two thirds. Large visible square pixels on a 64x64 grid, clean dark outlines, flat cel shading with 3 tones per material, warm sepia and muted earth palette, solid plain dark teal background. This is a faithful portrait: keep the same person, same age, same face shape, same hairline, same facial hair, same clothing as image 0. No text.

portraits.description: Young man, about 19, thin face, messy dark hair, faint thin mustache, dark jacket.
Pale-skinned man in his forties, receding hairline with short dark hair on the sides, large curled handlebar mustache, high white collar, striped tie, dark suit.
Pale-skinned man about 60, very short cropped grey hair, grey mustache, stern look, light Austro-Hungarian general uniform with high collar and star insignia.
